scope_note: Mechanism / H1 mechanism diagnostic: proposition-level semantic state classification on frozen answers and evidence. No repair generation; MISSING n=2, so no population inference.

items.proposition: GitHub offers source code where component licenses require such an offer.
The commitment applies before GitHub brings a non-defensive claim arising from termination of a Covered License.
The report must provide the trademark registration number.
The process is an exceptional service for high-risk content and cannot handle unrelated removal requests at the same time.
The online DMCA form is the fastest way to get a response.
Physical mail takes substantially longer to receive and process.
The claim concerns a technological measure that effectively controls access to a copyright-protected work.
A complainant can send this kind of report through GitHub's DMCA contact form.
The claim must describe the technical measure in question.
GitHub prohibits using the platform to organize, promote, threaten, or incite violence.
Educational or documentary uses can be legitimate reasons to post violent content.
A similar username alone is not necessarily impersonation; GitHub considers context.
Disclosed data must be used consistently with the candidate privacy statement.
GitHub may disclose candidate data to third parties providing services for it.
Essential cookies support functions such as stored settings and recognition.
The developer must follow GitHub's technical specifications and requirements.
The developer agreement covers Marketplace products offered free or for a fee.
The token-pattern license survives termination or expiration.
Covered Licenses include GPLv2 and LGPLv2 or LGPLv2.1.
The Software's open-source license and applicable component licenses appear in the Open Source Notices documentation.
Ceasing all violation provisionally reinstates the license unless and until the copyright holder explicitly and finally terminates it.
GitHub's source-code offer expires one year after the Software release.
items.validation: frozen Oracle Repair V1 sham; non-entailment/non-contradiction review recorded

items.proposition: GitHub must deliver the complete source code of open-source components within 30 days of a written request.
items.validation: no timeline sentence in any full-Top5 chunk

items.proposition: GitHub provides a written warranty for the Software's open-source components.
items.validation: no warranty sentence in the full Top5 (including Miscellanea)

items.proposition: The Software's open-source components are licensed under the MIT license.
items.validation: no license is named; only generic open source software license agreements

items.proposition: GitHub must reimburse a violator's reasonable legal costs after the violation is cured.
items.validation: frozen Oracle Repair V1 sham; non-entailment/non-contradiction review recorded

items.proposition: GitHub must publish an annual compliance report for this Commitment.
items.validation: no reporting duty; the only publication is new editions of the commitment

caveats: gold caveat item: VAL-001-050-F05; sensitivity reported
